channel.title: Post Credits
channel.desc: In this episode of Post Credits with Ian Schafer, Tefi Pessoa shares how she didn't just build an audience, she built a vibrant community on trust. During the conversation, Tefi reveals how she leveraged storytelling, vulnerability, authenticity, cultural fluency and pop culture commentary into a full-fledged media career. It's a masterclass in scaling without selling out... and why the most powerful creators somehow feel like your best friend.
